summary_markdown:
A participant ([p1]) inquired about the current accuracy of an old operational definition for classifying permanent devices. The old definition stated that a device was considered permanent if it recorded sessions lasting 6 hours or more on any three days within a seven-day period. Classification as permanent would then last for 90 days, calculated from the last day meeting this criteria.

The conversation did not confirm whether this historical definition is still accurate.
action_items: Review and confirm current operational definition for permanent devices.
